REFERENCE_DEPENDENT is a declared limitation flag. It can coexist with a supported state and constrains the licence; it is not a terminal state.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(evaluably)
source(system.file("examples", "toy-workflow.R", package = "evaluably"))
```

The complete synthetic declaration is installed at
`system.file("examples", "toy-workflow.R", package = "evaluably")`.
Its scientific choices are illustrative declarations, never engine defaults.

```{r}
t <- toy_spec("SUPPORTED_WITHIN_DOMAIN")
s <- amend_audit(t$spec, "SCIENTIFIC", "Declare reference limitation", "example analyst",
                 list(flags = "REFERENCE_DEPENDENT"))
s <- freeze_audit(s)
r <- evidence_record(run_audit(check_audit(s, t$data), t$data), render = FALSE)
stopifnot(r$qualification$terminal_state == "SUPPORTED_WITHIN_DOMAIN",
          "REFERENCE_DEPENDENT" %in% r$qualification$flags)
r$interpretation_license$required_qualifiers
```
